text: ＊は　からだが　しびれて　うごけない

structure.jp: からだが　しびれて

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: しびれて　うごけない
patterns.explanation: The て ending here gives the reason for what comes next. しびれて　うごけない = 'is numb and so can't move'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing うごく to うごける means 'can move'; with ない it is 'can't'. うごけない = 'can't move'.

patterns.name: 〜は〜が
patterns.span: ＊は　からだが　しびれて
patterns.explanation: は names who we are talking about, and が names the part of them that the rest is about. ＊は　からだが　しびれて = 'as for ＊, its body is numb'.
